title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity
raw_excerpt: Google has released its latest frontier model, Gemini 4 Carbon, offering "significant gains" in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity. In an announcement on Wednesday , Google highlights Carbon's top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) benchmark, with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra trailing behind. The new Gemini 4 Carbon model offers improvements over Argon, which Google released earlier this month. It's currently only available to a select group of cybersecurity defense companies, but it will eventually expand to other partners in its Fairwind Program . The company says Carbon reflects the "pace at which we're pus … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Google 发布新一代前沿模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，官方称在编程、智能体任务与网络安全上实现「显著跃升」，并在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 上登顶，领先 Claude Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra。目前仅向少数网络安全防御公司开放，后续将通过 Fairwind 计划扩展。这是 Google 在「AI 攻防」这一高敏感赛道上首次以专用模型切入，值得关注其能力边界与开放节奏。

title: Google Introduces Genie 4
raw_excerpt: Genie 4 is a world model that generates photorealistic, interactive environments with synchronized audio and real-time prompt-based editing. It can maintain consistent simulations for up to two minutes, doubling Genie 3's duration, while improving physics and character realism.
summary: Google DeepMind 推出世界模型 Genie 4，可生成照片级真实、可交互的环境，并同步生成音频、支持实时提示词编辑。其一致性模拟时长可达两分钟，是 Genie 3 的两倍，物理与角色真实感同步提升。世界模型正从「生成视频」走向「可玩环境」，这对具身智能训练、游戏与仿真数据生产都有直接价值。

title: Liquid AI Launches LFM3 Models for On Device AI
raw_excerpt: LFM3 is a family of open weight text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models built on a shared tri-hybrid backbone, starting in the 2B parameter range. The 1.7B text model beats its 2.6B predecessor with 35% fewer parameters, fits in about 1 GB at 4 bit precision, and supports a 256K context window for agents running on device. LFM3-VL-2B adds video input and matches Gemma 4 12B across 62 vision benchmarks, and every model in the family fine-tunes on a single GPU.
summary: Liquid AI 发布 LFM3 系列开放权重模型，覆盖文本、视觉、音频、全模态与决策模型，共享三混合主干，起步 2B 参数。1.7B 文本模型以少 35% 的参数超越前代 2.6B，4bit 量化后约 1GB，支持 256K 上下文，面向端侧智能体；LFM3-VL-2B 增加视频输入，在 62 项视觉基准上追平 Gemma 4 12B，全系可在单卡微调。

title: Formalizing the Enormous Theorem
raw_excerpt: Axiom Math has released the first complete computer-checked proof of the Classification of Finite Simple Groups (CFSG). The original CFSG proof is considered to be the longest mathematical proof ever written by humans. It spans roughly 15,000 pages in more than 500 articles written by about 100 mathematicians. Engineers and mathematicians at Axiom Math directed swarms of dozens of AI agents over 24 days in a project that produced approximately 43.1 million lines of code in the Lean proof assistant.
summary: Axiom Math 发布有限单群分类定理（CFSG）的首个完整机器可验证证明。该定理原证明被视为人类史上最长数学证明，约 1.5 万页、500 余篇论文、约百位数学家参与。团队指挥数十个 AI 智能体历时 24 天，在 Lean 证明助手中产出约 4310 万行代码。这是 AI 参与超大规模形式化的标志性案例。

title: Anthropic's Claude Refutes the Exponential Time Hypothesis, With a Lean Proof (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: Anthropic says an internal research Claude model found, with no human input, a deterministic algorithm that counts the satisfying assignments of 3-SAT formulas in 2^O(n log log n/√log n) time, which would make 3-SAT subexponential and refute ETH. This repository holds the paper and a Lean 4 formalization written by AI models that builds in about 8 minutes, though Anthropic notes no machine checks that the Lean statement matches the paper and the result says nothing about practical SAT solving. It landed hours after OpenAI's own ETH refutation.
summary: Anthropic 称内部研究版 Claude 在无人类输入下，找到判定 3-SAT 可满足赋值数量的确定性算法，复杂度为 2^O(n log log n/√log n)，若成立将使 3-SAT 次指数化并推翻指数时间假设（ETH）。仓库同时给出论文与 AI 撰写的 Lean 4 形式化，约 8 分钟构建完成。Anthropic 也提示尚无机器校验 Lean 陈述与论文一致，且对实际 SAT 求解无直接影响。

title: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
raw_excerpt: Researchers have developed a new way to enable large language models to integrate new facts and enhance reasoning without catastrophic forgetting or static knowledge cutoffs. The sleep framework equips large language models with a continuous periodic lifecycle, enabling them to continually learn and consolidate fragile short-term context into stable long-term parameters. Alternating between active interaction and offline memory consolidation allows LLMs to continuously acquire new facts, retain long-context knowledge up to 10M tokens, and improve complex reasoning.
summary: Google Research 提出「睡眠框架」，让大模型像生物一样在「主动交互」与「离线记忆巩固」之间周期性切换，把脆弱的短期上下文压缩进稳定的长期参数，从而持续学习新事实而不发生灾难性遗忘。实验显示可保留长达 1000 万 token 的上下文知识并提升复杂推理。这为 LLM 摆脱静态知识截止提供了新范式。

title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
raw_excerpt: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand their partnership to bring OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow and ServiceNow workflows into ChatGPT and Codex.
summary: OpenAI 与 ServiceNow 扩大合作，将 OpenAI 模型与智能体嵌入 ServiceNow 工作流，同时把 ServiceNow 的企业流程接入 ChatGPT 与 Codex。这意味着企业级工单、IT 运维、HR 等场景可直接调用前沿模型，而 ChatGPT 侧也能触发真实业务动作。对企业 AI 落地而言，这是「模型厂商 + 流程平台」深度绑定的又一典型案例。

title: Nvidia to Invest $3 Billion in Meta's Equity Offering as They Expand AI Partnership
raw_excerpt: Meta intends to increase the development of Nvidia infrastructure, and the companies are considering working together in other areas like monitoring agent behavior.
summary: 据 WSJ 报道，Nvidia 将向 Meta 的股权发行投资 30 亿美元，双方同时扩大 AI 合作：Meta 计划加大 Nvidia 基础设施部署，并在监控智能体行为等方向探索联合工作。芯片巨头以股权投资绑定超大客户，进一步模糊了供应商与股东边界，也反映 AI 算力军备竞赛正转向资本层面的深度结盟。

title: The Download: dead startups fueling AI and interspecies communication
raw_excerpt: This is today’s edition of The Download , our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. AI labs are buying data from dead startups to train their models When Keelan Miskell began winding down his crypto startup, he didn’t think its data was worth much. But he’s since turned the company’s digital archives into tens of thousands of dollars, selling its codebase and workspace data. He’s part of a growing market in which companies that help shut down startups sell their data to AI labs. Demand has grown as training labs hit the limits of public and synthetic datasets, with buyers seeking real-world records to help train AI agents. But the sales raise legal and ethical questions. Read the full story on the AI labs buying up the remains of failed startups . —Matthew King Are we there yet? Interspecies communication Humans are far from the only species with a gift for gab, and our furry, feathered, and finned friends could have a lot to tell us. Decoding how animals communicate with one another could reveal the inner lives of other species—and give humans a window onto how they see the world. A growing arsenal of devices and advances in AI have made it easier to study their howls, squeaks, and clicks, but making sense of it all remains complex. summary: MIT Technology Review 报道，AI 实验室正从「死掉的创业公司」购买数据：一家加密创业公司创始人把公司代码库与工作区数据卖给 AI 实验室，获利数万美元。随着公开数据触及上限，关停初创企业的数字档案成为新的训练数据来源，催生出一个中间商市场。这揭示了数据供应链的灰色地带与合规风险。

title: TauricResearch/TradingAgents
raw_excerpt: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
summary: GitHub 项目 TradingAgents 登上趋势榜，单日新增 654 星。它是基于多智能体 LLM 的金融交易框架，把研究、情绪、交易决策等角色拆分为协作智能体，模拟真实投研流程。此类项目把智能体编排从「写代码」扩展到高 stakes 的金融决策场景，也引发对回测有效性与风险控制的讨论，适合关注 Agent 落地的人研究。
